notes: OpenSky CSV is the research standard for ADS-B data. Fields match the StateVector object. Timestamps are Unix epoch (integer seconds), NOT ISO 8601. Altitude in meters (OpenSky uses metric). ADS-B Exchange uses feet and slightly different field names — do NOT mix the two schemas.

fields.name: icao24
fields.notes: ICAO 24-bit transponder address, lowercase hex, from aircraft_registry.json. US civil addresses start with 'a'; US military and Coast Guard with 'ae'.

fields.name: callsign
fields.notes: 8 characters, space-padded. The aircraft_registry.json callsign; registry call signs longer than 8 characters keep their first six characters and their two-digit number (GUNSMOKE02 appears as GUNSMO02, JAVELINA31 as JAVELI31, PELICAN21 as PELICA21, RIDGELINE01 as RIDGEL01). Join on icao24, not on callsign.

fields.name: origin_country
fields.notes: Inferred from ICAO24 block

fields.name: time_position
fields.notes: Unix epoch of last position report; null if more than 15 s since last fix. 2027-09-14T00:00:00Z = 1820880000.

fields.name: last_contact
fields.notes: Unix epoch of last received message of any type

fields.name: longitude
fields.notes: WGS-84 decimal degrees

fields.name: latitude
fields.notes: WGS-84 decimal degrees

fields.name: baro_altitude
fields.notes: Barometric (pressure) altitude in METERS, standard setting; blank on the ground. Differs from geo_altitude by the weather: in the low pressure of the hurricane it reads several hundred metres high.

fields.name: on_ground
fields.notes: True if surface position report

fields.name: velocity
fields.notes: Ground speed in m/s

fields.name: true_track
fields.notes: Direction of travel, degrees true 0–360, clockwise from north

fields.name: vertical_rate
fields.notes: m/s; positive = climbing, negative = descending

fields.name: sensors
fields.notes: Comma-separated receiver serial numbers; blank if no filtering applied

fields.name: geo_altitude
fields.notes: GNSS height in meters (use this for height above the ground near sea level).

fields.name: squawk
fields.notes: 4-digit octal transponder code. 1200 = visual flight rules, 1277 = search and rescue; other values are assigned codes.

fields.name: spi
fields.notes: Special Purpose Indicator — ident button pressed

fields.name: position_source
fields.notes: 0=ADS-B, 1=ASTERIX, 2=MLAT (multilateration: position computed by the receiver network, not reported by the aircraft), 3=FLARM

fields.name: category
fields.notes: ADS-B emitter category (OpenSky numbering): 0=no info, 1=no category info, 2=light, 3=small, 4=large, 5=high vortex large, 6=heavy, 7=high performance, 8=rotorcraft, 14=unmanned aerial vehicle. aircraft_registry.json adsb_emitter_category.

fields.name: nic
fields.notes: Navigation Integrity Category 0-11 from the aircraft operational status / position messages (extension to the state-vector export). Normal GPS gives 8 or more; values drop when the GPS signal is degraded.

fields.name: nac_p
fields.notes: Navigation Accuracy Category for Position 0-11 (extension, same source as nic). Normal GPS gives 9 or more.

registry.aircraft_id_format: ACF-<operator>-nnn, ACF-02nn (military airlift), ACF-03nn (civil relief charter)
registry.airfield_id_format: FAA location identifier (CRP, NGP, NQI, NFW...)

files: adsb_YYYY-MM.csv, one file per calendar month (UTC), rows sorted by time_position then icao24
